Total Dissolved Solids                Report           Report     Report             Report    1/Quarter (*1)

rationale: The obligation bundles Flow, Cyanide Total Recoverable, and TDS. The packet grounds Cyanide Total Recoverable and Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) as report-only monitoring in part_i (effluent limit cells read 'Report', not a numeric limit), which would support REJECT for those parameters under the oracle contract (numeric exceedance comparison not applicable). No selected observation addresses Flow or maps the obligation label 'Flow' to a permit row, so applicability for that parameter cannot be established. ACCEPT would require grounded evidence that numeric comparison is applicable for the full parameter set; REJECT for the bundled obligation would require establishing non-applicability for all three. Neither burden is met. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to closing on partial evidence.
